answer: Randomized cross-examination stops bulk fakes by making every identity answerable live. Each epoch, 5% are drawn for a ten-minute session with unrelated examiners; a missed or evasive answer freezes the identity. A grove of examiners cannot be prearranged, as pairs change each epoch. The k-th fake needs its own responder, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 responders at 2 credits each, while an honest agent answers once. An island of self-vouching fakes is exposed to outsiders. A relic record of evasions bars re-entry; rented responders share timing and freeze the cluster.
